title: My Son Forged My Signature, Drained My $143K Retirement, Left Me $4,300. So I Seized His Bikes
description: My adult son forged my signature and drained my $143,000 457(b) retirement account, leaving me with a $4,300 corrective refund notice. A handwriting analyst proved the forgery, the plan reversed the distribution, and I seized his party bike fleet as restitution. Now he greases chains for Pedal of Deceit Party Bike Tours in a Grifter on Board shirt. #FamilyBetrayal #FinancialFraud #RevengeStory
thumb_text: MY SON DRAINED MY RETIREMENT SO I SEIZED HIS BIKES
pinned_comment: If your own son forged your signature and drained your $143,000 retirement account, would you have seized his party bike fleet or let him keep it? Share your story in the comments if a family member ever touched your money.
